title: Meta to report Q2 earnings amid AI investing concerns
excerpt: Meta will report its Q2 earnings after the bell on Wednesday.
content_html:
Meta (META) will report its second quarter earnings after the bell on Wednesday, giving Wall Street its latest look into the company's AI investments and whether they're paying off.

The announcement comes as Meta stock continues to struggle to regain its footing and investors question CEO Mark Zuckerberg's capex plans. The company has said it plans to spend upwards of $145 billion this year, with the bulk of that going to its data center build-out.

On Tuesday, Meta and BlackRock announced they are entering into an agreement to build a $14 billion, 1-gigawatt data center in Texas. BlackRock will hold an 80% stake in the site, while Meta will get the remaining 20%.

Shares of Meta are off nearly 10% year to date and roughly 16% over the last 12 months. Out of the "Magnificent Seven" stocks, only Microsoft (MSFT) stock has lagged more in the last year, dropping 24% on similar concerns about the company's AI spending.

But Meta has also given investors some hope more recently. Earlier this month, Zuckerberg told Bloomberg that it makes sense for the company to explore leasing out some of its data center capacity to customers. 

It's not clear how Meta would structure any deals, but it could turn toward SpaceX (SPCX) for inspiration. That company has set up multibillion-dollar arrangements to rent access to its AI capacity to Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) and Google (GOOG, GOOGL).

Meta could also choose to operate similarly to a neocloud company like CoreWeave and simply rent out its hardware as is.

The company also debuted its new Musk Spark 1.1 model this month and revealed an aggressive pricing scheme that significantly undercuts the cost of using models from OpenAI and Anthropic.

Meta charges developers $1.25 per million input tokens and $4.25 per million output tokens. Anthropic currently charges $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens for its Opus 4.8 model, which Meta compares with Spark 1.1.

By setting prices so low, Meta could take market share from the big AI labs as price-conscious customers seek better deals on AI models.

For Q2, Meta is expected to report earnings per share of $7.14 on revenue of $60.23 billion, according to Bloomberg analyst consensus estimates. The company saw EPS of $7.14 and revenue of $47.51 billion in the same period a year ago.

Advertising revenue is projected to come in at $58.99 billion, up 26% from the $46.56 billion the company brought in in Q2 2025. 

Capex, however, is set to increase 100% to $33.15 billion for the quarter.

content_html_zh:
Meta (META) 将于周三盘后公布第二季度收益，让华尔街了解该公司人工智能投资及其是否获得回报的最新情况。

这一消息发布之际，Meta 股票仍在努力重新站稳脚跟，投资者对首席执行官马克·扎克伯格的资本支出计划提出质疑。 该公司表示，今年计划支出超过 1,450 亿美元，其中大部分用于数据中心扩建。

周二，Meta 和 BlackRock 宣布达成协议，将在德克萨斯州建设一座价值 140 亿美元、1 吉瓦的数据中心。 贝莱德将持有该网站 80% 的股份，而 Meta 将获得剩余的 20% 的股份。

Meta 的股价今年迄今已下跌近 10%，过去 12 个月下跌约 16%。 在“七大”股票中，只有微软 (MSFT) 的股票在去年表现不佳，因对该公司人工智能支出的类似担忧而下跌了 24%。

但 Meta 最近也给投资者带来了一些希望。 本月早些时候，扎克伯格告诉彭博社，该公司探索向客户出租部分数据中心容量是有意义的。

目前尚不清楚 Meta 将如何构建任何交易，但它可能会向 SpaceX (SPCX) 寻求灵感。 该公司已达成数十亿美元的协议，将其人工智能能力出租给 Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 和谷歌 (GOOG, GOOGL)。

Meta 还可以选择与 CoreWeave 等 Neocloud 公司类似的运营方式，直接按原样出租其硬件。

该公司本月还推出了新的 Musk Spark 1.1 模型，并公布了激进的定价方案，大大降低了使用 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 模型的成本。

Meta 向开发者收取每百万输入代币 1.25 美元的费用，每百万输出代币 4.25 美元的费用。 Anthropic 目前对其 Opus 4.8 模型收取每百万输入代币 5 美元和每百万输出代币 25 美元的费用，Meta 将其与 Spark 1.1 进行了比较。

通过将价格定得如此之低，随着对价格敏感的客户寻求更优惠的人工智能模型交易，Meta 可以从大型人工智能实验室手中夺取市场份额。

根据彭博社分析师的一致预测，Meta 预计第二季度每股收益为 7.14 美元，营收为 602.3 亿美元。 去年同期，该公司每股收益为 7.14 美元，营收为 475.1 亿美元。

广告收入预计为 589.9 亿美元，比该公司 2025 年第二季度的 465.6 亿美元增长 26%。

然而，本季度资本支出预计将增长 100%，达到 331.5 亿美元。
